features: Adds post-deployment Production target verification in the deployment worker
A Production job can no longer remain successful unless the configured Production path reports the exact deployed commit SHA and production environment
False-success deployments are changed to failed and the release is returned to approved so it can be retried after the target-path issue is corrected
Successful Production jobs now record a PRODUCTION_TARGET_VERIFIED marker with version, commit SHA and configured Production path
Keeps the existing DeploymentPipelineService implementation unchanged after restoring the previous known-good version
No Staging or Production deployment performed
